description: Course-arm tasks for Lab 9, Parts A-C (illustrative). Biomedical: move a 0.25 kg sample carrier from the ready pose to a centrifuge rack (A -> B), via a waypoint above a tray (A -> W -> B). Defence (protective): the same arm on an EOD training rig lifts a 0.25 kg inert mock package (A -> C). Short move A -> D: dip the forearm 0.1 rad at joints 2 and 3 to seat a sample tube.
